reader_inner_cv_vs_outer_oof_gap.reading: Inner CV is pessimistic by construction (trains on 2/3 of outer train). Negative gap means the inner selection score is LOWER than outer OOF, so inner-based selection is not optimistic here; the C/tau selection is not inflating the reported OOF.

conclusion_so_far: No Track A arm shows a statistically supported macro-F1 gain over the same-environment baseline on HAM dev or PAD dev (all paired CIs include 0). HAM mel->NV reduction for 448_cls4_d4 is consistent in direction across 3/3 encoder seeds but is point-estimate only. Track B metadata fusion gives the largest PAD gain (+0.07 at 224), but its HAM effect is negative at 224 and has no OOF-based CI yet.
